name: Package Dimension Explorer
blurb: physical sizes of packages from 0201 to QFN, compared to scale
intro: Draws the top view of common SMD packages, from 01005 chips to a 17 mm BGA, all at one scale, and lists their nominal body size, height, size with leads and pitch. Add your own block (length × width) to see what fits.

inputs.label: Only these
inputs.help: Names or parts of names, separated by commas. Empty shows the whole group.

inputs.label: Your own block
inputs.help: Length × width (× height) in mm, drawn dashed, e.g. a module or a connector.

examples.title: All IC packages against a 10 × 8 mm module

usage: Give group (all, chip, discrete, ic), an optional comma-separated filter of package names (e.g. '0402, SOT-23, QFN'), sort (area or list) and optionally a custom block 'LxW' or 'LxWxH' in mm. It returns each package's nominal body size, height, size with leads, pitch, pin count, area and area relative to 0603, and result.shapes with the outline geometry the drawing uses. Use it to compare sizes or pick the smallest package that suits assembly.
sources: EIA-198 / IEC 60115 chip sizes (inch and metric codes)
JEDEC MS-012, MO-153, MO-187, MO-220, TO-236, TO-261, TO-252 and DO-214 outlines (nominal values)
